content.rendered:
Nice guy I DJed for your daughter Jayla graduation here in the Bay Area. Hall of Famer Larry showed me his Super Bowl rings and college football. The strongest guy in the NFL. Rip Larry was very nice to meet you Thank you .

Thank you Hall of Fame Larry Allen I only met you once but you inspired me and kept it real. Rest in Peace. Love & Respect to your family I know you will be greatly missed. Thank you .
